thread:
alex: quick sync — onboarding zenith-28b. weights are staged but tokenizer is producing different token counts vs our reference. can folks eyeball?

maria: path to weights? i can run a quick load+tokenize check.

alex: s3://redwood-models/zenith/28b/v1/{pytorch_state.bin,tokenizer.json,config.json}

jin: ran a tokenize smoke — punctuation handling differs (commas merge in ref, we split). example: 
```python
text = 'hello, world'
ref = ref_tokenizer.encode(text) # len=3
ours = zenith_tokenizer.encode(text) # len=4
```
looks like a special-casing rule for ascii punctuation.

sam: hmm could be tokenizer version mismatch. which tokenizer library did ref use? huggingface tokenizer v0.14 vs our internal v0.12 causes offsets.

alex: config.json included "tokenizer_revision": "hf-0.14" — we must ensure the runtime picks that. i'll open a tiny patch.

maria: also saw RoPE scale drift on long sequences in local perf test — attention patterns decay after ~2048 tokens. not sure if it's an MQA/GQA mismatch or a RoPE scaling flag.

jin: what flags do we currently set for this model? from the onboard manifest: 
```json
{"use_gqa": "auto", "slice_kv": true, "rope_scale": 1.0}
```
if ref used rope_scale ~= 1.02 we could get drift.

sam: suggest: set use_gqa=false for canary, rope_scale=1.02, run unit sequence test (seq len 4k) and kv-consistency check. if passes, flip canary to full.

deploy-bot: onb-checker: started canary job zenith-28b @ canary-cluster-03 (job id cb-9812). results ETA ~ 12m.

alex: thanks. also tokenizer mapping issue — jin, can you dump the first 20 token ids for the problem string from both tokenizers and paste? will map differences.

jin: pasted below: 
ref_ids: [154, 7, 312, 2]
ours_ids: [154, 11, 7, 312, 2]
looks like we inserted an extra split token for comma. probable vocab mismatch.

maria: quick workaround: enable tokenizer_fallback="ref-vocab" in serve config so runtime normalizes token boundaries for this model until we rebase vocab. small perf hit but ok for rollout.

sam: updating canary config: 
```yaml
model: zenith-28b/v1
serve:
  tokenizer_fallback: ref-vocab
  rope_scale: 1.02
  use_gqa: false
  sliding_window:
    enabled: true
    overlap: 128
```
applied to cb-9812.

deploy-bot: onb-checker: canary job cb-9812 finished. smoke tests: token-counts match ref ✅; kv-cache continuity ✅; latency within 95th percentile target; small regression in memory (~+60MB) due to fallback.

alex: excellent. next steps: 1) open PR to vendor-tokenizer to upstream comma rule, 2) add a quick lint in onb pipeline to assert tokenizer_revision matches manifest, 3) schedule a full dedicated canary with use_gqa true to measure perf delta.

maria: i'll handle PR. leaning to keep fallback off by default for Dedicated. will add lint as well.

jin: noted — i'll create a tiny test in runtime/test/tokenizer_compat_test.py that asserts token_count(reference, sample_text) == token_count(runtime, sample_text) for a small prompt set.

sam: pinging infra to reserve a small dedicated slot for full perf test next week — @infra-team please. :slightly_smiling_face:

alex: thanks all. re-open if anything flaps, otherwise i'll mark onboarding as "canary-verified" after the upstream tokenizer PR lands. :thumbsup:
